purpose: 2026-10-10 DFT-informed campaign, S1_repairs. Generated by analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/make_campaign_configs.py from campaign_matrix.json (entries verbatim, matrix order). Design: analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/CAMPAIGN_DESIGN.md.
global_rules: Sequential only: python scripts/run_campaign.py <plan> (C10 plans refuse --workers != 1). Every launch counts, failed or not. Hard cap 200: config/solver.yaml max_launches 260 (= 60 used before C10 + 200) and a C10 label counter (c10_* run IDs in RUN_INDEX <= 200) in run_campaign.py.

run_campaign.py (C10 plans) never re-launches an entry whose label already has a RUN_INDEX row, from this or any other C10 plan (MIN10 vs stage plans): a successful earlier launch is reused, a failed one is reported; --retry ID spends a new (reserve) launch on purpose.
Model file for every entry: $env:IWO_MODEL_FILE = "config/iwo_material_model_v3.yaml" (V3 + the overrides = the same solver statements as V2 + the overrides, check_v3_equivalence.py).
After any code change: python analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/regress_all_decks.py must print "unexpected differences 0" before the next launch.

run_campaign.py records a failed launch and CONTINUES; it does not apply any stop rule below. The main session reads results/campaigns/<plan>.json and analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/post_run_checks.py output after each plan and decides.
stop_rules: Draft amendment PA-1 (S1-06R): invoke only after PA-1 is logged in the register (amendment heading naming S1-06R) and the decision log, after the Codex check and the manual check (ATLAS 5.28), with the user's go for THIS launch, and immediately after analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/prelaunch_gate_c10.py has exited 0 naming S1-06R as the next run (same PowerShell session, package root). One launch (label c10_s1_06r_13p2, timeout 3600 s); run_0073 (S1-06) is kept untouched and never substituted; no --retry, no second repair.

Repair form (frozen 2026-10-15): the S1-06 deck plus a 0.05 V continuation across V_G -1.8 ... -1.6 V (solver.sweep.continuation=-1.8:-1.6:0.05): LOG OFF after the -1.8 V solve, -1.75/-1.70/-1.65 V solved unlogged, LOG OUTF=transfer.log APPEND, then -1.6 V logged. Tolerances, mesh, models, DOS, carriers and timeout are those of S1-06. The logged, exported and scored V_G grid is the registered 76-point grid; requested_points 76.

Read-out (S1 rule, CAMPAIGN_DESIGN S1 block): campaign_extract.py compare <S1-06R run> run_0069 --rule s1_06 (S1-02 = run_0069; common V_G points of the two runs only, |dI/I| <= 1e-3 wherever both |I| > 1e-14 A/um). PASS: electron-only stays and is now TESTED at 13.2 nm. FAIL (rule fired): STOP and re-plan with Codex and the user before any further launch. A failed or invalid S1-06R (timeout, non-convergence, incomplete export): electron-only stays ASSUMED and is stated as a limitation; no second repair.

Placement: S1-06R completes and is read before DIAG inv3 (S2-03); default (user, D-58 item 1): the first launch, before DIAG inv1 (B1 = S2-04). The C10 pre-launch gate refuses every DIAG launch until the S1-06R row exists and its S1-rule record is PASS or the run is invalid (electron-only ASSUMED).
stop_rules_enforced_by: main session (manual); run_campaign.py enforces the launch budget and refuses runnable=false plans
